requirement.description: The AsyncOptionBuilder.__call__ method incorrectly handles generator execution, causing None values to be returned instead of proper Option types. Multiple tests fail with TypeError: unsupported operand type(s) for +: 'NoneType' and 'NoneType' and similar issues due to incorrect handling of StopIteration and None values.
requirement.contract: When an async_option builder function is called, it should properly process generators and return either Some(value) or Nothing based on the generator's execution flow. The method must correctly handle StopIteration exceptions and properly extract values from yielded expressions.

requirement.description: The SeqBuilder.__call__ method has incorrect handling of generator execution, particularly around StopIteration and None values. Tests fail with assertion errors about missing expected values or incorrect return values.
requirement.contract: When a seq builder function is called, it should properly process generators and return a sequence of values. The method must correctly handle StopIteration exceptions and properly extract values from yielded expressions, ensuring that the final result is properly returned.

requirement.description: The base Builder._send method has incorrect logic for handling StopIteration and None values. This affects all derived builders (async_option, async_result, seq) and leads to incorrect return values or unhandled exceptions.
requirement.contract: The _send method should properly handle StopIteration exceptions by extracting values correctly and returning the appropriate result based on whether a value was yielded or not. When StopIteration occurs with a value, it should return that value; when it occurs without a value, it should return the zero value.
requirement.acceptance: All tests that rely on proper StopIteration handling in the base builder
